subject: Autonomous electric vehicle driving at night through city streets in dense fog
action: Vehicle moves smoothly forward, LiDAR dome on rooftop faintly pulses with cyan infrared visualization beam
camera: Low angle front tracking dolly shot moving backward ahead of the car
lighting: Moody cinematic night streetlights with cyan laser rim highlight
exitVector: Dolly In directly towards the rooftop sensor dome

subject: Automotive Solid-State LiDAR dome assembly separating in mid-air
action: Polycarbonate housing lifts upward, revealing optical collimating lens, VCSEL laser emitter array, and SPAD silicon receiver board
camera: Slow orbital rotation 45 degrees left around the suspended floating components
lighting: Clean dark slate studio lighting, specular chrome reflections, electric cyan accent rim
entryVector: Dolly In continuing from rooftop dome
exitVector: Macro Probe Push-In towards the laser array chip

subject: VCSEL semiconductor laser array firing micro-pulses of 905nm infrared light
action: Microscopic laser cavities emit invisible light pulses visualized as sharp electric cyan photonic rings expanding outward at high frequency
camera: Extreme macro probe lens gliding over the golden wire-bonded microchip surface
lighting: Subtle dark backdrop with self-illuminated glowing laser apertures and circuit traces
exitVector: Fast forward zoom tracking light pulse traveling into the street

subject: Infrared laser wavefront striking a pedestrian obstacle and bouncing back toward the detector
action: Collimated laser beam hits obstacle surface, diffuse reflection photons bounce back along the return path into SPAD avalanche photodiode sensor
camera: Side profile cross-section shot tracking beam travel with glowing timecode clock counter HUD
lighting: Dark atmospheric night simulation with volumetric laser beam lines
exitVector: Cutaway push into the receiver SPAD silicon layer

subject: Raw laser reflection data transforming instantly into a high-density 3D LiDAR point cloud
action: Millions of neon dots pop into existence, reconstructing the exact 3D wireframe geometry of road, vehicles, trees, and pedestrians in real time
camera: Crane up and rotating perspective view above the vehicle revealing the 360-degree digital twin environment
lighting: Pitch black background filled with luminescent cyan, amber, and purple point cloud coordinates
entryVector: Reverse pull out from sensor to overhead
exitVector: Smooth slow zoom back into vehicle cockpit display screen

subject: LiDAR sensor seamlessly reassembling into the car's aerodynamic roofline
action: Components snap together with high precision, AUDIRA TECH logo emerges in electric cyan neon
camera: Cinematic center locked-off shot with subtle lens flare sweep
lighting: Studio dark luxury finish with pulsing cyan neon branding
